Results in invalid SSL certificates in Chrome, such as self-signed ones, being ignored.

## CLI flag

```text
--ignore-certificate-errors
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)
- [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`getCompositionsOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/getcompositionsonlambda#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#ignorecertificateerrors)

## Config file

```tsx twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';

// ---cut---

Config.setChromiumIgnoreCertificateErrors(true);
```
